review_scope: Current completed outputs only; update after the pending matched experiments finish.

H4_no_trajectory_control.motion: Cup moves down/near the starting location, modest lift later, then down again. No top exit or wide rightward group_00 arc.
H4_no_trajectory_control.cup_identity: Starts as one blue cup with face motif, becomes partly transparent and eventually a flattened blue/silver fragment.
H4_no_trajectory_control.local_gripper: Moves with the deformed object on a different path; does not follow frozen forecast.
H4_no_trajectory_control.proximal_robot: Forearm changes pose under prompt, mainly near the left start; mounted upper column remains largely in place.
H4_no_trajectory_control.artifacts: Severe loss of cup silhouette and motif; flattened object by the end; wrong spatial path.
H4_no_trajectory_control.acceptance: Rejected for the requested cup arc; retained as the matched no-control ablation.
H4_no_trajectory_control.acceptance_ru: Без control модель двигает руку около исходного места, но не воспроизводит большую дугу; стакан становится прозрачным и затем плоским фрагментом. Вариант отклонён.

H1_group00_2s_no_prior.motion: Large approximate arc occurs within the first 2 seconds, then holds near the intended right endpoint. Continuous recognizable cup motion is not accepted.
H1_group00_2s_no_prior.cup_identity: Early cup and gripper become severely deformed and merge with a metal-like elongated strip. A blue cup with motif returns on the right later.
H1_group00_2s_no_prior.local_gripper: Deforms during fast travel; later visible above the right cup.
H1_group00_2s_no_prior.proximal_robot: Remains stationary; residual elongated material remains below the left wrist.
H1_group00_2s_no_prior.artifacts: Major shape and material changes; long-lived silver strip on the left; tracker loses the cup and lacks a usable final track.
H1_group00_2s_no_prior.acceptance: Rejected as a clean continuous full-arc video; retained as the matched physical-timing experiment.
H1_group00_2s_no_prior.acceptance_ru: Большое перемещение приблизительно выполняется за первые 2 с, но стакан и захват теряют форму; остаётся серебристый фрагмент на исходном месте. Вариант отклонён как непрерывное качественное движение стакана.

H2_group00_6s_no_prior.motion: Lift on the left, partial exit above the frame, rightward re-entry, lowering to the raw forecast endpoint above/right of the brown cup.
H2_group00_6s_no_prior.cup_identity: One recognizable blue cup with the white printed motif; silhouette and motif deform during travel.
H2_group00_6s_no_prior.local_gripper: Travels with the cup; contact judged visually, not certified by physical reconstruction.
H2_group00_6s_no_prior.proximal_robot: Mostly static; the local moving gripper becomes disconnected from the proximal arm. Not accepted as realistic robot kinematics.
H2_group00_6s_no_prior.artifacts: Small light fragment late in the clip; changes in cup silhouette and printed motif.
H2_group00_6s_no_prior.acceptance: Accepted for the requested full spatial cup arc. Appearance and full-arm realism remain limited.
H2_group00_6s_no_prior.acceptance_ru: Один узнаваемый голубой стакан проходит полную дугу, захват следует за ним. Пользователь принял дугу; основная рука неподвижна. Есть деформации рисунка и небольшой светлый фрагмент в конце.

H3_group00_6s_prior025.motion: Lift, partial top exit, rightward re-entry and descent along the unchanged group_00 arc.
H3_group00_6s_prior025.cup_identity: One recognizable blue cup with a white face motif; less silhouette/motif drift than H2, but small distortions remain.
H3_group00_6s_prior025.local_gripper: Travels with the cup; visual contact remains plausible.
H3_group00_6s_prior025.proximal_robot: Upper arm and forearm remain essentially stationary; local moving unit is disconnected.
H3_group00_6s_prior025.artifacts: Minor changing cup shape, printed detail and gripper appearance; static proximal robot.
H3_group00_6s_prior025.acceptance: Accepted for full cup arc and useful t0 prior comparison; whole-body realism requires the requested H5.
H3_group00_6s_prior025.acceptance_ru: Полная дуга сохранена, форма и рисунок стакана устойчивее, чем в H2; ошибки трекера меньше. Основная рука по-прежнему неподвижна.
